fixes.why: The name fixes hand width, not foot width, so the hip-width stance facet should not be fixed.
"Wrist Roll(s)" is the usual name of the weighted wrist-roller exercise, so it would mislead as a sure match here.
Wrist circumduction combines flexion, extension and radial/ulnar deviation; the pronators and supinator rotate the forearm and do not drive it.
"Palm facing away or upward, fingers pointing toward the floor" is contradictory; the stretch starts with the palm facing away and fingers down.
The roller is held with arms extended in front at shoulder height, not at the sides as "at-sides" says, and no enum term fits.

uncertain: Equipment lists "strap" as a stand-in for the wrist roller itself (dowel and cord); the vocabulary has no wrist-roller term, so decide whether to add one.
